elements.name: q_1
elements.title: Why might someone be unable to rotate their device?
choices: It may be mounted to a wheelchair

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: When can content be restricted to one orientation under 1.3.4?
choices: When that specific orientation is essential

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: Does passing orientation testing automatically establish reflow conformance?

answer_key.q_1: It may be mounted to a wheelchair
answer_key.q_2: When that specific orientation is essential

explanations.q_1: Mounted devices can be difficult or impossible to rotate.
explanations.q_2: The exception applies when the orientation is essential to the content or operation.
explanations.q_3: Reflow has its own test conditions and dimensions.
